question: What is the main criterion used by the World Bank in classifying different countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Per Capita Income.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The main criterion used by the World Bank in classifying different countries is the **per capita income or average income of a person in a country.**
 
• This criterion is used by the World Bank in its** World Development Reports.**
